title: Battling the trumpeter Doll Jones
summary: Roy describes meeting the woman trumpeter Doll Jones in a Detroit joint, who cut him until mid-afternoon, and lists other trumpeters there.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Not the least bit. I'll tell you who did impress me, though. There was a girl that played trumpet whose name was Doll Jones.
Oh, I've heard about her, yes.

Yes. She... I went in this joint; I used to go there and play. You know, when you're a trumpeter, you always have your little thing that you do to be different. And ....(?)...(?)... go around spacey or something. But mine was to be able to play and be different, and be different in my actions, you know. So I would go in and before I'd speak to anybody, I'd go to the bar...
In Detroit, and you said Doll Jones... Oh, you said you used to have a thing where you'd walk into the place, and you'd go up to the bar...

Yeah. Well, see, I'd stand outside at first and see who I heard playing, you know. And this night I heard a trumpet player... It wasn't the night that Bix was playing. Because I heard this trumpet player playing, and I stood outside, getting high, you know, and listening... And when I come in, they was on their break, you know. So I

went to the bar and had my taste, and then I had another taste, so I could carry one up on the bandstand with me. So the girl was sitting up there with her long dress on, holding the trumpet, you know, and ...(?)>.. I was tuning my horn up, you know. So I said, "Where's the trumpet player?" She said, "I'm the trumpet player." I said, "Shit..." -- to myself, you know. So the guys come up, and we all spoke, you know. Well, nobody said anything. So I see her still holding the horn, and I say, "Now, this is going to be a joke." Boy, this chick tore it on that trumpet, and my mouth flew open. Ha-ha, I couldn't believe it. Do you know, we battled until two o'clock in the afternoon, two or three o'clock in the afternoon? She could play. The last time she came down to Ryan's, she had had trouble with her teeth, and she was (?); she didn't get to nothing....
Oh, she was still around that recently.
At that time, when you first ran into her, was she about your age, or a little older?
I couldn't tell. Maybe she might have been a little younger than me. At least as old as I was, I know. She wasn't older than me. Well, I really couldn't tell, to
tell you the truth, because you really don't be thinking in terms like that when somebody's playing. At least that's the way I was then, you know. All I know is she played good.
There was several cats out there who played good trumpet, man. (?)Bobby Lee(?)...
